# Boulder CO Painters

> Painting company serving Boulder County, Colorado. Interior and exterior house painting, historic and landmark homes, cabinet refinishing, deck and timber staining, zero-VOC work, rental turnovers, commercial and HOA. Over 20 years of Colorado experience, fully insured, written 5-year workmanship warranty.

Phone: 720-208-5645
Service area: Boulder County and the canyon communities above it, plus Estes Park. Not the Denver metro.

## Services
- [Interior painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/interior-house-painting/): Interior painters working across Boulder County: walls, ceilings, trim, stairwells and basements, with zero-VOC options and a written 5-year warranty.
- [Exterior painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/exterior-house-painting/): Exterior house painters in Boulder County: washed, scraped, caulked and primed before paint, with products chosen for 5,430-foot ultraviolet exposure and chinook winds.
- [Historic homes](https://bouldercopainters.com/historic-home-painting/): Historic home painting in Boulder's landmark districts: Landmarks review support, lead-safe work practices, wood window and porch restoration prep.
- [Cabinet refinishing](https://bouldercopainters.com/kitchen-cabinet-refinishing/): Cabinet refinishing in Boulder: degreased, sanded, bonding primed and sprayed to a factory-smooth finish for a fraction of replacement cost.
- [Deck and fence staining](https://bouldercopainters.com/deck-and-fence-staining/): Deck, fence and timber staining in Boulder County: cleaned, brightened, sanded and sealed for high-altitude ultraviolet exposure and freeze-thaw.
- [Zero-VOC painting](https://bouldercopainters.com/zero-voc-painting/): Zero-VOC and low-VOC painting in Boulder: what the labels actually mean, where the real trade-offs are, and honest answers about odor and durability.
- [Rental turnovers](https://bouldercopainters.com/rental-turnover-painting/): Rental turnover painting in Boulder: fast durable repaints between leases, built around the CU academic calendar and investor deadlines.
- [Commercial and HOA](https://bouldercopainters.com/commercial-and-hoa-painting/): Commercial and HOA painting in Boulder County: Pearl Street retail, Gunbarrel offices, labs and phased community exteriors with resident notification.
